paragraphs: Rav Idi bar Idi (bar Gershom), [Chullin 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.98a.9); Rav Huna son of Rav Idi, [Rosh Hashanah 24b:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.24b.4); Rav Hoshaya son of Rav Idi, [Yevamot 36b:12-14](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.36b.12-14); Chalafa bar Idi, [Vayikra Rabbah 16:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.16.1); Rabbi Chinena bar Idi, [Shabbat 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.63a.21); Rabbi Chinena bar Idi (a Tanna), Shevuot 34b; Rav Chanilai bar Idi, [Ketubot 79a:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.79a.2), and [Yoma 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.22b.7): Rabbi Nehilai bar Idi; Rav Yehuda bar Idi, [Rosh Hashanah 31a:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.31a.13); Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rav Idi, [Berakhot 4a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.4a.10); Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi, [Berakhot 29b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.29b.7); Mar bar Idi, [Yevamot 106b:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.106b.10); Rav Machseya bar Idi, [Yoma 2a:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.2a.8); Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Idi, [Gittin 30b:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.30b.10); Rav Ilaa son of Rav Idi, [Bava Kamma 42a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.42a.6); Rav Simi son of Rav Idi, [Menachot 25a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.25a.9); Rav Shisha or Rav Sheshet son of Rav Idi, [Berakhot 17b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.17b.9), [Shabbat 138b:2-3](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.138b.2-3).[^3][^4][^5]

notes.text: This is a list indexed by the father-name Idi. Its separate sons do not establish that all the fathers named Idi are one person.

The directly consulted Chullin 98a chain names Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom. This supports that occurrence, not an identification of all fathers called Idi in the index. The listed sons, titles and alternative names remain separate.
Chullin gives the full chain with Idi son of Idi son of Gershom. Yoma reads Nehilai bar Idi and transmits in Shmuel’s name. Each passage supports its local form.

In [Vayikra Rabbah 16:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.16.1), Rabbi Chiyya and Chilfa bar Idi report a teaching in Rabbi Yose’s name. [Ketubot 79a:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.79a.2) has Rav Chanilai bar Idi quote Shmuel. [Yoma 2a:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.2a.8) calls Machseya “Rabbi” in the chain from Rav Minyomi to Rabbi Yochanan. [Bava Kamma 42a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.42a.6) reads Ulla where Hyman has Ilaa. [Menachot 25a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.25a.9) gives Idi and Ashi as alternative patronymics for Sima. [Berakhot 17b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.17b.9) names Shisha, and [Shabbat 138b:2-3](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.138b.2-3) names Sheshet. The Shevuot 34b reference for the Tanna remains unconfirmed.
The baraita at [Shevuot 35b:24](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.35b.24) explicitly names Rabbi Chanina bar Idi in the discussion of oaths, curses and the divine name. Hyman cites Shevuot 34b.
